lessons: Redo the full ticket from the merge base. Review found the Attempt model, write_attempt/read_attempt/call_keys, the harvest hook, the docs edit and the TrainingData() config edits sound. Only the path decoding in the clutch/runner.py diff split failed review.

In the clutch/runner.py diff splitter, decode git C-quoted header paths as UTF-8 bytes, e.g. ast.literal_eval('b' + part).decode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape'). Plain ast.literal_eval turns "a/secr\303\251t.key" into Latin-1 mojibake, so non-ASCII exclude globs never match.

Add a case to tests/unit/test_runner_attempt_manifest.py: with training_data.exclude=['secrét*'] and a diff touching 'secrét.key' plus app.py, the stored blob keeps the app.py section and has neither the secrét.key path, in quoted or plain form, nor its content.

Match effective_exclude() globs against the decoded full path and its basename. This applies to both a/ and b/ header paths and to rename/new-file lines, so an excluded path's name never reaches the blob (ticket Definition of rejected).
